title: Your Jeans Have A Pocket For A Gadget From The 1800s
hook: You are wearing a fitting for a device nobody owns.

cast.note: Mochi steals the pocket watch during the history beat and keeps it. No one comments.

scenes.note: Bill is already looking down into the tiny pocket at frame 0. Jeans fill the lower frame.

beats.action: Bill standing, one thumb hooked in the small pocket, staring down into it
Bill tugs the small pocket open wider and peers in like it is a cave
beats.sync: secondary action — closes a pacing gap

beats.action: camera punches to the tiny pocket; an 1800s date card stamps beside it
Bill looks up at camera, deeply confused by his own trousers

scenes.note: Three wrong answers pop in and are rejected. Rhythmic, fast, one per keyword.

beats.action: tight on the front pocket; the little pocket inside it outlines in coral
he tries a folded receipt; it goes in and immediately will not come out
beats.sync: secondary action — closes a pacing gap

beats.action: a coin tries to go in and is crossed out
an earbud case tries to go in, does not fit, is crossed out
Bill jams a finger in and it wedges; he cannot get it out for a beat

scenes.note: The reveal. A pocket watch slides in and fits perfectly — that fit is the whole episode.

beats.action: the frame goes sepia for four frames — an old photograph feel, then back
a pocket watch lowers into the little pocket and seats perfectly; a satisfying click
a teal PERFECT FIT tick pops beside it

scenes.note: Compressed history. Bill becomes the 1800s worker; Mochi steals the watch mid-scene.

beats.action: Bill in a flat-cap silhouette as a period worker, pocket watch on a chain
he tucks the watch into the small pocket and pats it; a protective glow
Mochi pads in behind him, hooks the chain, and walks off with the watch
beats.sync: keyword: protected — the gag runs under the fact

scenes.note: The extinction event, in two props. Wristwatch in, pocket watch out, pocket stays.

beats.action: the wristwatch ticks smugly on his wrist while the old watch outline fades further
beats.sync: secondary action — closes a pacing gap

beats.action: a wristwatch straps itself onto Bill's wrist with a snap
the pocket watch fades to a grey outline and blows away
everything else clears out of frame; the tiny pocket remains, alone, unbothered

scenes.note: Museum framing for a seam. Mochi is visible in the background still wearing the watch.

beats.action: back to Bill; the little pocket gets a museum plinth and a velvet rope
the plinth gets a tiny brass rail; the pocket sits there being historic
beats.sync: secondary action — closes a pacing gap

beats.action: a FOSSIL placard stamps under it; Bill looks at it like an exhibit
Mochi strolls past the background wearing the stolen pocket watch; Bill does not notice; hard cut
beats.sync: keyword: nobody carries anymore — final beat
